batch_review.box_progression: The confirmed sample establishes recognition, application, and transfer. Cards 001204–001212 add three further waves: ordinary stop boundaries, approximate-sound recovery, and high-score error/cluster discrimination, without adding a new interaction family.
repetition_or_gap_risks: All nine expansion assets are disclosed simulations and still require complete human perceptual audio QC.
Cards 001207–001212 use meta-pronunciation explanations rather than exam excerpts; they provide controlled concept discrimination but should not be presented as authentic CET material.
Cards 001207, 001209, and 001210 depend on explicit error-correction framing because their retained legacy audio explanations contain incomplete English or an omitted phoneme-boundary layer.
Formal content use remains blocked until a separate explicit final user approval record exists.
batch_review.next_step: Keep the 12-card box candidate-only, complete human perceptual audio QC, then include it in a separately user-approved formal batch before product import.
